verdict.rationale: The evidence describes ByteAsk only as a terminal agent. It shows diffs in a full-screen TUI, and /agents groups sessions, but nothing documents a desktop app with visual diff review or side-by-side sessions. The TUI diff and the agent command center are adjacent terminal features, not the desktop-app capability the story asks for. The IDE connectors are mentioned without any diff-review or multi-session detail.

support.subject: As a developer, I can review diffs visually and run multiple sessions side by side in a desktop app
